name: Taka Takahiro
source:
Something of a national treasure, at least to the elderly of the nation who appreciate his old timey vibes and nostalgic positive. Taka Takahiro is famous for his constant presence on TV and infamous for his questionable presence on social media. Once a beloved retirement home stable, bringing the industry back to it's roots. Taka is now more well known for his questionable social media exploits in an attempt to attract a younger audience.

Taka appears to be endlessly confused about the severity of his own situation, instead believing the prison to be an opportunity to change his image through relatable gen-z quotes and general antics, Without a certain other prisoner wrangling him in I'd consider him a liability. But he's mostly harmless, if just really annoying.

He went completely quiet when we asked about his crime, seemingly annoyed we were ruining his fun.

[From the [url=https://danganronpa-fanganprojects.fandom.com/wiki/Taka_Takahiro_(Danganronpa_Antebellum:_LOCKDOWN)]Wiki[/url]]
